name: Count
postgresql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications;

name: Max
postgresql: SELECT MAX(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;
duckdb: SELECT MAX(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;

name: Min
postgresql: SELECT MIN(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;
duckdb: SELECT MIN(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;

name: Avg
postgresql: SELECT AVG(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;
duckdb: SELECT AVG(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;

name: Sum
postgresql: SELECT SUM(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(papers) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS papers FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ) AS paper_count;

name: Concat
postgresql: SELECT pub.id, string_agg(Authors.name) FROM Publications as pub LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth ON pubauth.publication_id = pub.id LEFT JOIN Authors ON pubauth.author_id = Authors.key GROUP BY pub.id;
duckdb: SELECT pub.id, string_agg(Authors.name) FROM Publications as pub LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth ON pubauth.publication_id = pub.id LEFT JOIN Authors ON pubauth.author_id = Authors.key GROUP BY pub.id;
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?paper (GROUP_CONCAT(?author_label) as ?labels) WHERE { ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?author rdfs:label ?author_label . } GROUP BY ?paper

name: Contains/ Like
postgresql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications WHERE title LIKE '%Database%';
duckdb: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications WHERE title LIKE '%Database%';

name: Order By
postgresql: SELECT year, id FROM Publications ORDER BY year;
duckdb: SELECT year, key FROM Publications ORDER BY year;

name: Regex Filter
postgresql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Authors WHERE name SIMILAR TO '.*Nguyen.*';
duckdb: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Authors WHERE name SIMILAR TO '.*Nguyen.*';
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) as ?count) WHERE {
  ?author rdf:type dblp:Person .
  ?author rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER REGEX(STR(?label), ".*Nguyen.*")
}

name: Materialize Small
postgresql: SELECT id FROM Publications LIMIT 1000;
duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications LIMIT 1000;
sparql:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT * WHERE {
  ?paper rdf:type dblp:Publication .
}
LIMIT 1000

duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications;

duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE type = 'book' UNION SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE type = 'incollection';

duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE type = 'article' UNION SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE type = 'inproceedings';

name: Minus Small
postgresql: SELECT id FROM Publications EXCEPT SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE year >= 2000;
duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications EXCEPT SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE year >= 2000;

name: Minus Large
postgresql: SELECT id FROM Publications EXCEPT SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE year <= 2000;
duckdb: SELECT id FROM Publications EXCEPT SELECT id FROM Publications WHERE year <= 2000;

name: Optional / Left Join Small
postgresql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id;
duckdb: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id;

name: Optional / Left Join Large
postgresql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Authors LEFT JOIN Affiliations ON Authors.id = Affiliations.author_id;
duckdb: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Authors LEFT JOIN Affiliations ON Authors.id = Affiliations.author_id

name: strlen
postgresql: SELECT SUM(length(title)) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(length(title)) FROM Publications;

name: strbefore
postgresql: SELECT SUM(length(regexp_substr(title, '([^a]*)a.*'))) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(length(regexp_extract(title, '([^a]*)a.*', 1))) FROM Publications;

name: strafter
postgresql: SELECT SUM(length(regexp_substr(title, '[^a]*a(.*)'))) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(length(regexp_extract(title, '[^a]*a(.*)', 1))) FROM Publications;

name: strstarts
postgresql: SELECT SUM(starts_with(title, 'a')) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(starts_with(title, 'a')) FROM Publications;

name: strends
postgresql: SELECT SUM(starts_with(reverse(title), 'a')) FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT SUM(ends_with(title, 'a')) FROM Publications;
